claims.claim: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held a virtual meeting on currency markets following President Trump's summit comments.
claims.episode_span: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama and U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent discussed currency markets in a virtual meeting. The talks followed comments by President Trump at a recent Japan-U.S. summit.
claims.source_title: US, Japan finance chiefs discuss yen after Trump raises concerns in summit
claims.supporting_quote: Japanese Finance Minister Satsuki Katayama held a virtual meeting Friday with U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, following up on the discussion of financial markets at Tuesday's Japan-U.S. summit.
